Display podcast tags at the top of the Subscriptions screen
# Checklist

- [x ] I have used the search function to see if someone else has already submitted the same feature request.
- [x ] I will only create one feature request per issue.
- [x ] I will describe the problem with as much detail as possible.

# System info

**App version**: 2.2.1
**Source**: F-Droid

# Feature description

Currently I have around 40 subscriptions of podcasts with a vast range of topics: Local audiobooks, history, linux, politics, travel, languages etc. 
Therefore, it's hard to find straight forward the right podcast.  Unfortunately the sorting and the filter feature are hardly helpful here.



**Suggested solution**:
Categories, as I have already mentioned a few above, which the user could create and to which the user could add podcasts.


**Screenshots / Drawings / Technical details**:

There could be two sort of tiles now: Category tiles on top and podcast tiles below, which have not yet been categorized.

![MockUp_small](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318127/127771255-f46ef271-7f66-4282-b88f-9790109107d7.png)       ![MockUp2_small](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318127/127776861-a9aee853-86d1-466a-97d2-679da568ff24.png)




The user could add a new category with some custom name and icon via the context menu of the three dots on the top right.
Podcasts could be assigned a category or more categories by
* drag and drop
* long press on a podcast, add to category: A cateogry chooser would open
* In the opened categories folder, there could be a button "add podcast" or "add existing podcast"

If the user clicks on the category, it opens and presents all containing podcasts.
